newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht up, interbank rate steady in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht up, interbank rate steady in late trade.

text.p: The Thai baht edged higher against the dollar in late trade on Monday supported by heavy dollar selling in afternoon trade, dealers said.
"Dollar selling was very strong in the afternoon. Some players were trying to unwind their long dollar positions," said one dealer at a U.S. bank.
He said baht sentiment is also improving as the market has already discounted worry about the health of most finance companies.
The baht was traded at 25.937/25.942 per dollar late compared with 25.941/25.951 early in the morning.
The Bank of Thailand set the mid-rate at 25.95 per dollar against 25.93 on Friday.
The overnight interbank rate was steady at 8.00-8.50 percent late, unchanged from morning trade, dealers said.
"The market was quiet with very few borrowers. The interbank rate is likely to stay at this level tomorrow," said one money market dealer.
The one-month baht/dollar swap premium was traded at 10.50/11.50 satangs per dollar late compared with 12.00/13.00 earlier, dealers said.
